text_block_list.text:
At the "Furlong Tower,"
various events are held regularly.
And now, once again—

text_block_list.name: Collab Staff
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your cooperation
on the "Tracen Academy Collaboration" project.
Please enjoy the advance preview!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The merchandise matches the samples,
and looking around the collab booths,
there don't seem to be any particular flaws.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Phew. It's been a long road since the planning stage.
Looks like I can finally take it easy today—hm?
What is it, Brian? You look like you want to say something.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...We just walked around checking for problems,
and that was it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ? Yeah... What about it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We've toured everything, and found no issues.
Thank you sincerely for accommodating
our requests as well—

text_block_list.name: Collab Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Y-Yes, I see.
It's great that there were no problems, but,
well, um... D-Do you have any other impressions...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
............
...Sorry, but
let us go around one more time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Wha... Hey, Brian?!
Why are you pulling me! I was in the middle of speaking—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Quiet. Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"At the area modeled after the Academy's stage,
visitors dance along to the music,
and their score is displayed based on accuracy."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Look, we already checked this earlier.
There shouldn't have been any problems with the system—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: It's starting.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hey, isn't this your song?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That's how the game works.
...There, do your best. Make sure
you nail the wild kicking choreography, alright?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Shout into the Hollow." You're given
a prompt and shout your feelings about it.
The background is a projection, but it's well-made—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It says, "Shout what you like about the person next to you!"
...Well then, let's hear it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... What exactly are you trying to do?
Dragging me around all over the place, what's the point—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
............
...Did you have fun?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Collab Staff
text_block_list.text: Please enjoy the advance preview!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wait, could you have...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Haah, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It was fun.
It's been a while since I played around like that.
I'll be sure to tell the staff that this time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...This is the last stop.
"Capture a slice of everyday life
in a Tracen Academy classroom."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We use actual classrooms every day, so
this seems a bit redundant at this point—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ghk, hey?!
Brian...?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Get closer.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You are always so sudden.
Say it with words first, with words.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: This is faster than asking.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph.
...Clumsy fool.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Wait. That booth modeled after the cafeteria...
Isn't that the "Oguri Cap Challenge Corner"?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Go on. Try breaking her record for extra helpings,
Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: A-As if I could do that!!
